McClaran Orthodontics

Changing Lives, One Smile at a Time

Locally owned in Middle Tennessee for 16 years. Family orthodontics with Dr. Tiffany R. McClaran: braces, Invisalign and airway-focused care for kids, teens and adults.

Same orthodontist every visit

Dr. Tiffany R. McClaran owns and operates the practice, so you’ll see the same orthodontist every time, for every visit, from your first consult to the day treatment ends.

Airway-focused care

Dr. McClaran looks beyond the smile. Jaw size and tooth position can affect how your child breathes and sleeps, so we check the airway as part of every exam.

Free consultation

Meet Dr. McClaran, get answers to your questions, and leave with a clear plan and flexible payment options. No pressure, ever.

Get to know Dr. McClaran

Meet Dr. McClaran

Your neighbor, your orthodontist

Dr. Tiffany R. McClaran has been straightening smiles in Middle Tennessee for 16 years. She owns and operates the practice herself, so you’ll see the same orthodontist, Dr. McClaran, at every visit from your first consult to the day treatment ends.

As a mom of four, she connects with kids and parents in a way only a mom can. She knows how busy family life gets and what makes kids feel at ease. Expect clear answers, no jargon, and a team that remembers your name. You might even meet Lennon, our office therapy dog.
